_README: Cal Poly SLO's published registration calendar, transcribed from the Registrar's own
RULES FOR EDITING THIS FILE:
1. Every date here must appear VERBATIM on the page named in `source`. Not derived from a
neighbouring date, not inferred from last year, not 'about a week after the add deadline'.
The first draft invented two window start dates that way and both were wrong. Each window
therefore quotes the calendar rows it came from in its `note`.
2. Dates are Pacific LOCAL dates (America/Los_Angeles). cadence.mjs converts; do not
pre-convert to UTC here.
3. `term_code` is PeopleSoft's STRM, written only once the live class search has confirmed it
(see resolveTerm in term.mjs). null means 'not yet confirmed' — NOT 'guess it'.
4. A term missing from this file is not 'nothing happening'. An uncovered date reads as
UNKNOWN and keeps polling daily with a loud warning, and the file's own horizon warns
separately when it is running out.
5. Windows may OVERLAP — a term's 15-week and second 7.5-week sessions share one open
enrolment period. cadence.mjs takes the most intense match, and applies every matching
window's boundary rules, not just the winner's.
6. `to` is the last day anything can change, which is the LATE ENROLMENT APPEAL deadline, not
the add deadline — an approved appeal enrols a student and moves a seat.
7. `deadlines` are the dates seats actually move fastest: the published last-day-to-drop and
last-day-to-add. They exist BECAUSE of rule 6: once `to` became the appeal deadline, a
rule that tightened near `to` tightened a week late and left the two busiest days of each
session on the slow base interval.
8. The LAST DAY TO ENROL WITHOUT A PERMISSION NUMBER belongs in `deadlines` too, and is
arguably the busiest of them: it is the last day the whole unregistered population can
self-add, where the later add deadline is individually approved permission numbers.
Only the 15-week sessions have one — a 7.5-week session requires a permission number
from its first day of classes, so its published table has no such row.

terms.label: Fall 2026
terms.term_code_confirmed: in production since 2026-09-07 — the scraper has returned real Fall 2026 sections under this code

windows.note: 'May 11 Registration opens for registration appointments' … 'June 30 End of registration appointments for continuing students'. Unit cap 16 on May 30, 18 on Jun 10.
'August 10 New transfer and graduate student registration' … 'August 11-13 New first-year student registration'.
15-week: 'August 15 Open Enrollment begins (8:00 a.m.)' … 'August 21 Open Enrollment ends'.

SECOND 7.5-WEEK SESSION, whose own table reads 'August 15 Open Enrollment begins' and 'October 14 Open Enrollment ends'. Both published; the start is shared with the 15-week session. OVERLAPS the two windows around it.

15-week: 'August 24 Fall 2026 Classes Begin' … 'August 28 Last day to enroll in open classes without a permission number' … 'September 4 Last day to drop or swap classes' … 'September 14 Last day to add via Student Center with a permission number' … 'September 21 Last day to submit Late Enrollment Appeal'.

SECOND 7.5-WEEK SESSION: 'October 15 Classes begin' … 'October 20 Last day to drop or swap classes' … 'October 21 Last day to add classes with a permission number' … 'October 28 Last day to submit Late Enrollment Appeal'. All four rows are in the second-session table.

terms.last_day_note: NOT Sep 14, and not Oct 21 either. The 15-week add deadline passes Sep 14, the second 7.5-week session adds until Oct 21, and its late enrolment appeals are decided through Oct 28. Gating on any earlier date takes a term dark while its seats can still move.

SECOND 7.5-WEEK SESSION, whose own table reads 'November 18 Open Enrollment begins' and 'March 24 Open Enrollment ends'. Both published; the start is shared with the 15-week session.

SECOND 7.5-WEEK SESSION: 'March 25 Spring 2027 Classes Begin' … 'March 31 Last day to drop or swap classes' … 'April 1 Last day to add classes via Student Center with permission number' … 'April 2 Late appeal begins' / 'April 8 Late Enrollment Appeal period ends'.

terms.last_day_note: PLACEHOLDER — the Summer 2027 planning calendar was not published as of 2026-09-14. Only the schedule-available date (Feb 22, stated on the Spring calendar) and first/last day of instruction (Jun 1 / Aug 6, from the academic calendar) are known, and NO registration window is published. windows is EMPTY ON PURPOSE: cadence.mjs reports this term as UNKNOWN rather than silently treating it as dark.
